description: This file defines a React functional component called SettingsPage, which provides a user interface for viewing and diagnosing application settings. It includes functions for fetching backend health status via API requests and displays configuration details like API base URL and WebSocket URL.

methods.name: SettingsPage()
methods.description: React functional component that renders the settings and diagnostics page, including mechanisms to ping the backend and display health status.

methods.name: ping()
methods.description: Async function that sets the busy state, performs an API request to check server health, updates the health state with the response, and resets the busy state.
